pipeline.defaultTimeoutDescription: Maximum run time for a single pipeline task

pipeline.keepWorkspaceDescription: Keep intermediate files after tasks finish for easier troubleshooting
toast.savedRestart: Settings saved — restart required for some changes
toast.savedRestartDescription: This change touches restart-sensitive items (listen host/port, port range, workspace dir, CUDA libs dir, log level, proxy) — restart the daemon to apply.
general.logLevelDescription: Daemon log level. Requires restart; the daemon currently reads RUST_LOG at startup — backend wiring pending.
compute.cudaLibsDirDescription: Shared CUDA libs path injected at module start (LD_LIBRARY_PATH on Linux / PATH prepend on Windows), relative to app root
python.uvCacheDirDescription: uv dependency cache dir (hardlink dedup when same volume as venvs), relative to app root
python.constraintsDescription: Global constraints file pinning dependency versions (e.g. unified torch stack); empty = disabled
packs.title: Model packs
packs.stagingDirDescription: Isolated staging area for pack extraction and verification, relative to app root
advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.description: Advanced settings; make sure you understand each item before changing
advanced.activeModelsHint: One active variant per module (single slot). Existing keys are read-only; to remove a key edit config/app.toml manually
advanced.empty: No active-variant overrides (modules use manifest defaults)
advanced.keyReadOnly: Existing keys are read-only (merge semantics cannot delete/rename keys)
pipeline.keepWorkspaceNote: Experimental: post-task workspace cleanup is not implemented yet; this toggle has no effect
modulesLifecycle.title: Module Lifecycle
modulesLifecycle.description: Models load on demand and unload after idle to save memory/VRAM and power; they reload automatically on the next task.
modulesLifecycle.idleTimeoutDescription: Running modules idle beyond this duration are stopped automatically; 0 disables (always-on). Default 1800 (30 minutes).
logRetention.label: Log retention (days)
logRetention.description: Unified event logs and module log files older than this are cleaned up by an hourly sweep; 0 = keep forever (never clean). Default 90.
tasksRetention.title: Task artifact retention
tasksRetention.description: Unattended disk guard: every 6 hours the daemon sweeps terminal task directories and prunes them by age/total size. Queued and running tasks are never touched.
tasksRetention.enabledDescription: When off, nothing is cleaned up (default). When on, terminal tasks are evicted by the two limits below.
tasksRetention.maxAgeDaysDescription: Terminal tasks (completed/failed/cancelled) older than this are deleted together with their artifacts; 0 = unlimited.
tasksRetention.maxTotalGbDescription: When workspace/tasks exceeds this, the oldest terminal tasks are deleted until it fits, artifacts included; 0 = unlimited.
modulesAutoRestart.title: Module auto-restart
modulesAutoRestart.description: Running module processes that exit unexpectedly are restarted automatically; repeated failures trip a circuit breaker until a manual start. Only running-process deaths are healed—on-demand starts before tasks are unaffected.
modulesAutoRestart.enabledDescription: When off, crashed modules stay down (default). When on, restarts back off exponentially and the failure count resets after 10 minutes of stable uptime.
modulesAutoRestart.maxBackoffSecsDescrip: Failed restarts retry with exponential backoff starting at 2s and doubling each time, capped by this value; values below 2 are treated as 2.
modulesAutoRestart.circuitBreakerAfterDe: After this many consecutive failures, automatic restarts stop and an event is logged; start the module manually to reset. 0 disables the breaker.
security.title: Access protection
security.description: Require a shared token when exposing the API/WebSocket; off by default, enabling it changes previous behavior.
security.modeDescription: When enabled, /api/* and /ws* require a token; /api/v1 and pages/static assets are unaffected.
security.tokenDescription: Use a long random string; a configured token is never echoed—leave blank to keep it unchanged.
security.tokenWillClear: The access token will be cleared after saving
security.tokenHint: Takes effect in this browser immediately after saving
security.apiTokenHint: Note: global access protection does not re-check /api/v1 (inference, task queries/cancel, batches) — when [api].token is unset, v1 falls back to the access token ([server].token); set [api].token in config/app.toml for independent v1 credentials.
validation.token: An access token is required in token mode
error.loadFailed: Failed to load configuration. Retry or enter an access token.
authDialog.title: Access token required
authDialog.description: Access protection is enabled on the server. Enter the access token configured on this page.

llm.enabledDescription: Disabled profiles are kept but no longer used by downstream calls
